'''Tallan''' is a village in [[Ghealdan]].

==Activities==
[[Rand al'Thor]] passed through the village of Tallan on his way to [[Tear]]. [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Loial]] find that there were three murders after Rand's visit.{{ref/book|3|33}}
